title: C-3 — Cost model snapshot
description:
The most load-bearing artifact. Divyansh Shukla (A) produces these; Aditya's live scheduler AND B's DES both consume them. This is where the two halves of the project actually meet.

TWO REQUIREMENTS THAT FOLLOW FROM H3 AND ARE EASY TO MISS:
1. A must emit a TIME-ORDERED SERIES of snapshots during the calibration campaign, not one final fitted model. Staleness injection (F-8) means B serves the scheduler a snapshot from s seconds ago. If A emits only one snapshot, B has to synthesize aging by perturbing parameters — which makes H3 a study of B's perturbation model rather than of real drift. Real snapshot history makes H3 an empirical result.
2. stochastic.autocorr_time_s is MPR-1's headline number and is what F-22 uses to give the DES realistic variance. It is a deliverable, not a diagnostic.

ON `form`: F-7 permits a lookup table OR a <=6-parameter regression. Pick ONE and commit at end of Week 2 — supporting both doubles B's interpolation logic for no research gain.

cost_model_schema.description: §12.2 mitigation: B's loader MUST reject unknown versions loudly rather than defaulting.

snapshot_id.description: e.g. cm_rtx3090_awq_20260428T1412Z. Referenced per-node from the run manifest (C-6).

node_class.description: F-9: with engine and quantization held constant, a node class is defined by hardware PLUS engine_config (F-9a) — e.g. 'rtx3090_ngl99_p4_q4km'. Two machines of the same hardware running different -ngl are different node classes and need separate snapshots.

form.description: F-7. Commit to one at end of Week 2.

stochastic.description: F-22: the DES service-time model MUST include a stochastic component fitted to observed throughput variance.

provenance.description: The settings that eliminate the confounds, made auditable from the results. Under F-9 engine and quant are constant across the pool, so engine_config is what distinguishes one node class from another.

engine.description: 'llamacpp' for every pool node class. 'vllm' only for the F-9b engine-gap probe.

engine_config.description: F-9a runtime parameters this snapshot was calibrated under. Must match the manifest's node block for any run that uses it.
